svg.title: Compare Service Yield Without Pricing Claimant Outcomes
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-service-rail-contribution-yield; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Service Yield Without Pricing Claimant Outcomes; subtitle: Illustrative contribution dollars per delivered hour, before shared overhead.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Hourly equivalents normalize fixed or cost-plus service packages; they are neither market quotations nor payments for retaining a claimant. Each numeric value equals allocated service revenue less direct delivery cost per hour. These unit examples do not independently rebuild the canonical annual scorecard.; caption: Choose rails by administrative scope, documented cost, and collection reliability. Larger contribution per hour does not establish better evidence quality or permit legal fee-sharing.; stages: label: Exposure chronology package; value: $60 contribution per hour through fixed-scope ACH invoices; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Allocate $150 service revenue and $90 direct cost per delivered hour for source-linked exposure chronologies. Version the counsel-supplied evidence matrix and reserve clinical interpretation for qualified personnel.; label: Pharmacy proof coordination; value: $55 contribution per hour through cost-plus ACH invoices; numeric value: 55.0; detail: Allocate $130 service revenue and $75 direct cost per hour coordinating dispensing records and product identifiers. Disclose retrieval charges and price service effort without asserting a universal third-party patient-rate cap.; label: Medical device record desk; value: $50 contribution per hour through fixed-scope operating-account payments; numeric value: 50.0; detail: Allocate $125 service revenue and $75 direct cost per hour locating implant records, operative reports, and device identifiers. Missing lot numbers trigger a documented deficiency task rather than an invented match.; label: Retainer deficiency support; value: $45 contribution per hour through monthly administrative retainers; numeric value: 45.0; detail: Allocate $110 service revenue and $65 direct cost per hour resolving incomplete signatures and missing intake fields. Counsel handles conflicts and representation; administrative compensation does not depend on signing.; label: Paid-media administration; value: $40 contribution per hour through fixed management invoices; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Allocate $100 service revenue and $60 direct cost per hour to campaign administration and source auditing. Exclude direct client advertising spend from these unit figures and do not buy a share of recoveries.

text.tspan: Compare Service Yield Without Pricing Claimant Outcomes

circle.title: label: Exposure chronology package; value: $60 contribution per hour through fixed-scope ACH invoices; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Allocate $150 service revenue and $90 direct cost per delivered hour for source-linked exposure chronologies. Version the counsel-supplied evidence matrix and reserve clinical interpretation for qualified personnel.

label: Pharmacy proof coordination; value: $55 contribution per hour through cost-plus ACH invoices; numeric value: 55.0; detail: Allocate $130 service revenue and $75 direct cost per hour coordinating dispensing records and product identifiers. Disclose retrieval charges and price service effort without asserting a universal third-party patient-rate cap.

label: Medical device record desk; value: $50 contribution per hour through fixed-scope operating-account payments; numeric value: 50.0; detail: Allocate $125 service revenue and $75 direct cost per hour locating implant records, operative reports, and device identifiers. Missing lot numbers trigger a documented deficiency task rather than an invented match.

label: Retainer deficiency support; value: $45 contribution per hour through monthly administrative retainers; numeric value: 45.0; detail: Allocate $110 service revenue and $65 direct cost per hour resolving incomplete signatures and missing intake fields. Counsel handles conflicts and representation; administrative compensation does not depend on signing.

label: Paid-media administration; value: $40 contribution per hour through fixed management invoices; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Allocate $100 service revenue and $60 direct cost per hour to campaign administration and source auditing. Exclude direct client advertising spend from these unit figures and do not buy a share of recoveries.

Each numeric value equals allocated service revenue less direct delivery cost per hour. These unit examples do not independently rebuild the canonical annual scorecard.
